name: Girl in the Attic
source:
Girl in the Attic is a short suspense/thriller visual novel created for the 20 Second Game Jam.

[Edited from [url=https://strange-girl-studios.itch.io/girl-in-the-attic]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《閣樓裡的女孩》是一部為「20 Second Game Jam」創作的短篇懸疑驚悚視覺小說。

[編者根據[url=https://strange-girl-studios.itch.io/girl-in-the-attic]Itch.io[/url]改寫]
